name: Ocean City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Ocean City?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Ocean City, registered LSVs may use roads posted 25 mph or less, but not Bay Ave, West Ave, Route 52, the 34th Street bridge or Ocean Drive south of South Inlet Drive.

lsv.notes: Cross Bay Ave and West Ave at intersections

rules.rule: Plain golf carts aren't street-legal; only titled, registered and insured LSVs that meet 49 CFR 571.500
LSVs only on roads posted 25 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections
No LSVs on Bay Ave, West Ave, Route 52, the 34th St bridge or Ocean Dr south of South Inlet Dr

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Ocean City?
faq.a: Roads posted 25 mph or less. Cross Bay Ave and West Ave at intersections. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Asbury Avenue in Ocean City?
faq.a: Where Asbury Avenue is posted 25 mph or less, yes. Ocean City police list Bay Ave and West Ave as off limits, crossing only.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Ocean City?
faq.a: No. New Jersey only lets titled, registered and insured LSVs on public roads, so plain golf carts stay off the streets.
